summary: Rows containing color 8 form contiguous groups separated by empty rows. The first group is the template; its block of rows is copied onto every later group: for the k-th template row, every 8-cell strictly beyond the later group's frontier (its rightmost 8) is painted color 1 on row (group_start + k) — including rows past the later group's own rows. The output preserves the input and adds these blue extension cells.
